headphoneProfiles.name: Creative Inspire 5300
headphoneProfiles.source: Real product (Creative Inspire 5.1 5300, satellite+subwoofer PC speaker set, rated 47Hz-20kHz). No professional coupler/GRAS measurement of this specific unit is publicly available anywhere reachable (AutoEq, squig.link, Rtings all cover headphones/IEMs, not 2003-era budget PC speaker sets) — no curve is shipped rather than inventing one. Selecting this profile applies DeviceType.HomeSpeaker's documented, literature-cited class-average correction (see DeviceType.kt) at this unit's budget quality tier.

headphoneProfiles.name: TANGZU Wan'er S.G. 2 Red Lion
headphoneProfiles.source: Digitized from a user-supplied screen recording of the TANGZU SG 2 Red Lion Edition IEC711/ITU-T P.57 Type 2 coupler measurement (site: RAA) vs. the Harman In-Ear 2019 target, both traces present on-screen. Extracted programmatically: video frame -> per-pixel curve-color detection (blue=measured, orange=target) -> axis calibrated from the chart's own gridline/label pixel positions (log-linear regression on frequency labels, R^2 residuals <2px; 74.5px/6dB on the level axis) -> correction = target - measured at each of this app's 15 bands. Approximate (chart line width, video compression) but a real measurement, not invented. Every value already sits within the +-6dB device-correction budget, no rescaling needed.
